verdict.rationale: Sunbiz's public homepage offers a feature to "Find out where we are in processing your documents" (florida-dos-docs-23), and the site acts as the state's official public business entity index, searchable by name (florida-dos-docs-22, florida-dos-docs-15). Filed reports are posted immediately and can be viewed or downloaded once processed (florida-dos-docs-7, florida-dos-docs-14), so founders can check filing status from public pages. The robots.txt probe concerns crawler access, not the lookup capability, so it is not counted against it. Missing for 10: detail on how the processing-status lookup works (what identifier is needed, what status states are shown, coverage of applications/cases beyond document filings), independent or hands-on corroboration.
